inputs.text: [excited] SEE… loh… DON… tah. In Greek, "coelo" means hollow, [serious] and "donta" means teeth. The hollow tooth.
[happily] Exactly, people call it the Woolly Rhino. [serious] Not a dinosaur: it lived way later, in the Ice Age, [pauses] fifty thousand years ago, in the cold of Europe and Asia.
[curious] Who shared the cold with it?
[confident] The Woolly Mammoth, right nearby. [warmly] Both built for the snow.
